results.title: Sales FAE Engineer / Senior Sales FAE Engineer / Principal Sales FAE Engineer
results.description:
Job Title

Sales FAE Engineer / Senior Sales FAE Engineer / Principal Sales FAE Engineer

Department:

Technical Sales

Location:

Singapore (with regional travel across ASEAN, India, Greater China)

Reporting To:

Technical Sales Director / Head of Sales

Position Overview

Advinno Technologies is seeking a highly motivated and customer-focused

Sales FAE Engineer

to drive business growth in semiconductor manufacturing services, including Foundry, OSAT, Advanced Packaging, IC Design Services, Photonics, and EDA Solutions.

The successful candidate will serve as the technical bridge between customers and our ecosystem partners, supporting customers from initial engagement through quotation, project execution, tapeout, assembly, testing, and production ramp-up.

Depending on experience, candidates may be hired at

Engineer, Senior Engineer, or Principal Engineer

level.

Key Responsibilities

Business Development & Sales Support

  • Drive revenue growth for:
  • Semiconductor Foundry Services
  • OSAT & Advanced Packaging Services
  • Wafer Fabrication Services
  • IC Design & Layout Services
  • Photonics IC Services
  • EDA Software Solutions
  • Substrate Design & Manufacturing Services
  • Identify and develop new business opportunities with:
  • Fabless semiconductor companies
  • Research institutes
  • Universities
  • IDMs
  • Startups
  • Government agencies
  • Build and maintain customer relationships across engineering, procurement, and management teams.
  • Generate and manage sales pipeline, forecasts, and opportunities in CRM systems.
  • Support preparation of quotations, proposals, Statements of Work (SOW), and commercial negotiations.

Technical FAE Responsibilities

  • Understand customer technical requirements and convert them into executable solutions.
  • Provide technical guidance on:
  • Process node selection
  • MPW and shuttle programs
  • Wafer fabrication flows
  • Packaging technology selection
  • Reliability requirements
  • Yield optimization
  • Product qualification
  • Coordinate with external partners including:
  • Foundries
  • OSATs
  • Design service providers
  • IP vendors
  • EDA suppliers
  • Conduct technical presentations, workshops, and solution demonstrations.
  • Support customer design review meetings and engineering discussions.

Project & Program Management

  • Follow opportunities from RFQ through PO closure.
  • Coordinate project schedules among customers, foundries, OSATs, and internal stakeholders.
  • Monitor project milestones including:
  • Design completion
  • Tapeout readiness
  • Mask ordering
  • Wafer fabrication
  • Package assembly
  • Reliability testing
  • Production release
  • Manage customer expectations and resolve technical or commercial issues.

Market Development

  • Track semiconductor industry trends in:
  • AI hardware
  • Automotive electronics
  • Power management ICs
  • RF and mixed-signal ICs
  • Silicon Photonics
  • MEMS
  • Compound Semiconductors
  • Support participation in:
  • Industry conferences
  • Technical seminars
  • University collaborations
  • Customer workshops
  • Trade exhibitions

Engineer Level Requirements

Education

  • Bachelor's Degree in:
  • Electrical Engineering
  • Electronics Engineering
  • Semiconductor Engineering
  • Photonics Engineering
  • Physics or equivalent

Experience

  • 2 to 5 years experience in one or more areas:
  • Foundry services
  • IC design
  • Product engineering
  • Packaging
  • Semiconductor manufacturing
  • Technical sales
  • Applications engineering

Preferred Skills

  • Understanding of semiconductor manufacturing flow.
  • Basic knowledge of wafer fabrication and assembly processes.
  • Strong communication and presentation skills.
  • Ability to engage customers independently.

Senior Sales FAE Engineer Requirements

Experience

  • 5 to 10 years semiconductor industry experience.

Additional Competencies

  • Established customer network within semiconductor ecosystem.
  • Ability to independently close opportunities.
  • Experience with:
  • Foundry account management
  • Tapeout management
  • Customer qualification activities
  • OSAT engagement

Preferred Knowledge

  • One or more of the following:
  • TSMC
  • GlobalFoundries
  • Tower Semiconductor
  • X-FAB
  • UMC
  • SMIC
  • Amkor
  • ASE
  • JCET
  • Stats ChipPAC

Principal Sales FAE Engineer Requirements

Experience

  • 10+ years semiconductor industry experience.

Leadership Expectations

  • Drive strategic customer engagements.
  • Build regional business plans.
  • Mentor junior sales and FAE team members.
  • Lead complex multi-million-dollar opportunities.

Domain Expertise

Strong expertise in several of the following:

  • Advanced packaging
  • Chiplet integration
  • Heterogeneous integration
  • Silicon photonics
  • RF technologies
  • Automotive semiconductor qualification
  • Power semiconductor manufacturing
  • Wafer-level packaging
  • High performance computing and AI semiconductor solutions

Required Competencies

Technical

  • Semiconductor manufacturing flow
  • IC development lifecycle
  • Foundry business models
  • Packaging technologies
  • Yield and reliability concepts
  • Design-to-production methodologies

Commercial

  • Account management
  • Opportunity qualification
  • Negotiation skills
  • Revenue forecasting
  • Proposal preparation
  • Customer relationship management

Personal Attributes

  • Self-driven and entrepreneurial mindset
  • Strong customer focus
  • Excellent communication skills
  • Team player
  • Result-oriented
  • Comfortable working in a fast-growing technology company

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Annual sales revenue achievement
  • Gross margin achievement
  • New customer acquisition
  • Opportunity pipeline value
  • Proposal-to-order conversion rate
  • Customer satisfaction
  • Number of technical engagements conducted
  • Strategic account growth

Why Join Advinno Technologies?

  • Exposure to leading semiconductor foundries and OSATs worldwide.
  • Opportunity to work with AI, Photonics, Advanced Packaging, and Next-Generation IC technologies.
  • Regional business development opportunities across ASEAN, India, China, Europe, and North America.
  • High-growth environment with strong career advancement opportunities.

Salary Range:

Competitive base salary + sales incentive + performance bonus + travel allowance (based on experience and level).

results.title: Second Engineer
results.description:
The Second Engineer reports to the Chief Engineer and supervises routine and

scheduled operation and maintenance work in the engine department, or

other location as required.

The Second Engineer duties and responsibilities include:

- In charge of engine room in the absence of Chief Engineer.

- Responsible to the Chief Engineer for the efficient operation, maintenance

and repair of main machinery and all items of auxiliary machinery and brought

to the attention of the Chief Engineer immediately for any defects in

equipment.

- The Second Engineer is to familiarize himself and his subordinates in Engine

Room with the Company’s policies and Shipboard Operating Procedures

Manuals and conversant with the methods of use of all safety equipment and

emergency procedures.

- Responsible for advising the Chief Engineer of spare part requirements and

ensuring efficient state of preservation/stowed with documentation.

The Second Engineer shall be responsible to the Chief Engineer and shall

undertake duties as allocated by him as below.

• Keeping & maintaining engine-room watch as required.

• Assists in the upkeep & recording of the Inspection & Testing log.

• Assists in the preparation of docking / repair list.

• Assists in monitoring & controlling the usage of bunkers, lubes, stores,

spares, etc.

• Maintenance of lifesaving & fire-fighting equipment in engine room.

• Maintains the engine room in a safe &clean environment.

Requirements:

- COC Class II or I

- Minimum 3 years of experience on board as Second Engineer on Oil

/Chemical vessel.

- Good leadership, teamwork, management and communication skills

- Must be willing to follow Company planned working schedule on board

vessel.

results.title: IT Systems & Infrastructure Engineer
results.description:
About the Role:

We are looking for a hands-on and motivated IT Systems & Infrastructure Engineer to join our MIS team in Singapore. This is a broad infrastructure role covering Microsoft365, identity and access management, endpoint security, servers, backup and recovery, SaaS platforms, networking, hardware and data-centre operations.

You will work closely with our existing Network & Hardware Engineer and the MIS Manager, supporting CADIT users and systems globally. The role is designed for someone who wants to build a strong career in IT infrastructure and systems administration.

We are looking for someone who is curious, methodical, hands-on, willing to learn and genuinely interested in infrastructure. Training and certification support will be provided.

Key Responsibilities:

Microsoft 365 & Identity Administration

  • Administer Microsoft 365 users, licences, groups, shared mailboxes and permissions.
  • Support Exchange Online, SharePoint, OneDrive and Microsoft Teams.
  • Manage user joiner, mover and leaver processes.
  • Support Microsoft Entra ID, MFA, account access and password/lockout issues.
  • Maintain accurate documentation of tenant and access changes.

Endpoint & IT Support

  • Build, configure, deploy and maintain Windows PCs and laptops.
  • Install and maintain operating systems, applications, drivers, firmware and licensed software.
  • Provide first-line technical support for hardware, software, operating system, connectivity, printing and access issues.
  • Maintain endpoint protection and security coverage using Bitdefender GravityZone.
  • Monitor and respond to endpoint security alerts and escalate potential incidents appropriately.

Systems & Infrastructure Operations

  • Support the company's office server room and co-located data-centre rack.
  • Assist with server installation, configuration, firmware, RAID, operating systems and monitoring.
  • Perform hardware replacement including disks, power supplies, memory and fans.
  • Maintain rack equipment, cabling, labelling, UPS systems and physical infrastructure.
  • Coordinate data-centre access, remote hands and scheduled maintenance activities.
  • Maintain proper change records and infrastructure documentation.

Network &Infrastructure Support

  • Work alongside the Network & Hardware Engineer to learn and support:
  • Firewalls
  • VLANs
  • Switches
  • Wireless networks
  • IP addressing
  • DNS and DHCP
  • VPN connectivity
  • Handle routine network troubleshooting and changes under appropriate supervision.
  • Progressively develop the capability to provide infrastructure cover when the incumbent engineer is unavailable.
  • Support networking requirements for CAD-IT's IoT and project deployments where required.

Backup, Patching & Monitoring

  • Monitor backup jobs and investigate failures.
  • Perform and document periodic restore tests.
  • Support operating system and firmware patching activities.
  • Monitor infrastructure alerts and system health.
  • Maintain records for backup, recovery and business continuity procedures.

SaaS & Platform Administration

  • Administer CAD-IT's internal monday.com account, including users, licenses, permissions, workspaces and boards.
  • Support administration of other business SaaS platforms managed by MIS.
  • Maintain accurate user access and license records.
  • Identify opportunities to improve platform governance and operational efficiency.

Documentation & Asset Management

  • Maintain hardware and software asset registers.
  • Track licenses, warranties and equipment ownership.
  • Maintain network diagrams, rack layouts, cable schedules and technical documentation.
  • Create and maintain practical runbooks and standard operating procedures.
  • Ensure infrastructure changes are properly documented.

Global IT Support

  • Provide remote IT support to CAD-IT users and offices outside Singapore.
  • Communicate clearly with users across different time zones.
  • Explain technical issues in simple, non-technical language.
  • Maintain clear ticket updates and follow through until issues are resolved.

Continuous Learning & Development

  • Develop your skills across systems administration, networking, infrastructure and security.
  • Complete relevant training and certifications supported by the company.
  • Work towards Microsoft, CompTIA and other relevant infrastructure certifications.
  • Develop sufficient cross-functional knowledge to provide infrastructure coverage and support.

Requirements:

Must Have

  • Post-secondary qualifications in IT, Information Technology, Infocom Technology, Computer Engineering, Electronics or a related discipline.
  • Candidates with ITE Higher Nitec, Polytechnic Diploma or Degree are welcome to apply.
  • Relevant hands-on experience may be considered in place of formal qualifications.
  • Basic working knowledge of Windows operating systems and an understanding of Windows Server.
  • Basic understanding of networking concepts including:
  • IP addressing and subnets
  • DNS
  • DHCP
  • VLANs
  • Switches
  • Firewalls
  • Comfortable working with physical IT hardware, including PCs, servers, cabling and rack equipment.
  • Able to follow technical procedures carefully and document work performed.
  • Good spoken and written English, with the ability to communicate with users across different countries.
  • Strong attention to detail and a responsible approach to IT security and access management.
  • Willingness to participate in an emergency contact/on-call roster and occasional planned evening or weekend maintenance activities.
  • Genuine interest in IT infrastructure and systems administration.

Exposure to any of the following would be advantageous:

  • Microsoft 365 administration
  • Microsoft Entra ID / Azure AD
  • Microsoft Intune
  • Exchange Online, SharePoint, OneDrive or Teams
  • Endpoint security platforms such as Bitdefender, Microsoft Defender, CrowdStrike or Sophos
  • Business SaaS administration such as monday.com, Google Workspace or Atlassian
  • Firewalls such as WatchGuard, Fortinet, Sophos or pfSense
  • Managed switches and wireless networking
  • VMware, Hyper-V or Proxmox
  • Veeam or other backup platforms
  • PowerShell or basic scripting
  • ITSM / ticketing systems
  • Structured cabling, server racks, UPS or data-centre operations
  • Industrial, edge or IoT networking
  • CompTIA A+, Network+, CCNA or Microsoft certifications, including certifications currently in progress.

We are particularly interested in candidates who demonstrate:

  • Hands-on curiosity: You enjoy building, fixing and understanding how things work.
  • Methodical thinking: You troubleshoot logically rather than randomly changing things.
  • Attention to detail: You understand that small mistakes in infrastructure can have big consequences.
  • Ownership: You follow an issue through to resolution rather than simply passing it on.
  • Documentation discipline: You understand that good IT work should be repeatable and understandable by others.
  • Security awareness: You take access, credentials and endpoint protection seriously.
  • Service mindset: You understand that when someone's laptop or access is down, their work is blocked.
  • Willingness to learn: You are excited to grow from IT support into systems and infrastructure engineering.

Training & Career Development

This role is designed as a genuine infrastructure career pathway. You will receive exposure and training across:

  • Microsoft 365 and identity administration
  • Endpoint management and security
  • Servers and virtualisation
  • Networking and firewalls
  • Backup and recovery
  • Data-centre operations
  • Infrastructure documentation and IT operations

The company will also support relevant professional certifications and structured learning, with a road map that can lead toward specialisation in infrastructure, cloud/hybrid identity, cybersecurity, backup & virtualisation or networking.

Why Join Us?

  • Gain hands-on exposure across systems, infrastructure, networking, security and cloud platforms.
  • Work directly alongside an experienced infrastructure engineer.
  • Receive support for professional certifications and technical training.
  • Take ownership of real infrastructure responsibilities early in your career.
  • Support users and systems across an international organisation.
  • Build a strong foundation for progression into Systems Engineer, Infrastructure Engineer, Network Engineer, Cloud Engineer or Security roles.

How to Apply?

If you are passionate about IT infrastructure and want to build a career beyond traditional help desk support, we would like to hear from you. Please submit your updated CV outlining your technical experience, projects, certifications or any hands-on infrastructure work you have completed.

Fresh graduates and candidates from ITE and Polytechnic backgrounds with strong hands-on interests are encouraged to apply.

results.title: CSE Engineer Solution
results.description:
KONE moves two billion people every day. As a global leader in the elevator and escalator industry, we employ over 60,000 driven professionals in more than 60 countries worldwide joined together by a shared purpose, to shape the future of cities. In 2025, we had annual net sales of EUR 11.2 billion.

KONE has consistently been featured on Forbes list of World's Best Innovative Companies, World's Best Employers & World's Largest Public Companies.  At KONE, we believe in teamwork and a work culture where everyone can be who they are. This is exactly what makes us strong and successful.

Why this role?

A CSE Engineer, Solution provides technical expertise to the sales team, understands customer needs and transforms these needs into optimal KONE solutions. 

CSE Engineer, Solution is part of the KONE early engagement team, and ensures that KONE offerings and specifications are included into the customer’s building specifications.

CSE Engineer, Solution works at the customer interface, is an expert on solution selling and participates in customer meetings when needed. 

CSE Engineer, Solution takes into consideration all product and service costing and planning aspects when defining a solution e.g. corporate materials from the supply line, local materials from sourcing, costing of engineering, installation and impact on maintenance. 

What will you be doing?

Collaboration with sales: 

  • Responsible for finding optimal technical solutions to meet the customer’s needs for non-standard and modernisation cases  

  • Ensures clarity on the solution’s scope, including KONE and possible third-party offerings 

  • Participates in customer meetings and answers customers’ technical questions when needed 

  • Selects the correct product platform on which to make the offering 

  • Proposes solutions from all KONE business lines; new services, escalators, elevators, doors etc. 

Solution planning – Costing: 

  • Responsible for correct APF solution costings 

  • Involves CSE Engineer, Product to understand the costing for corporate and local materials 

  • Involves CSE Engineer, System to understand the costing for integrations 

  • Involves Supply Line, installation, maintenance and project management to understand both the materials and the service cost of the solution 

Solution planning – Specs: 

  • Coordinates specification creation 

  • Performs initial and revised non-standard energy calculations 

  • Performs traffic analyses 

  • Accountable for technical site surveys  

  • Accountable for the technical content of the order between MS 0b and MS 2z  

Solution planning – Availability and lead times 

  • Coordinates solution lead times from Supply Line and local sourcing

Solution planning – Installability 

  • Ensures that the proposed solution can be installed 

  • Ensures that the cost and work effort impact of installation is part of the solution’s costing, especially in non-standard installation method cases 

Solution planning – Maintainability 

  • Ensures that the proposed solution fulfils the customer’s product lifecycle needs 

  • Identifies possible deviations from standard maintenance methods and ensures that a resolution is found 

Solution planning – Compliance 

  • Ensures that the proposed solution fulfils local codes, regulations and safety requirements 

  • Ensures alignment with environmental regulations 

  • Ensures that the planned solution complies with KONE engineering policy  

Key tasks in the KONE Sales process 

  • Provides content for pre-tender and pre-booking reviews (technical solutions, costs, lead times, risks, verification of technical content in contracts) 

  • Executes activities for a holistic solution plan 

  • Leads full chain engineering teams on major projects until handover to the CSE Engineer, Project 

  • Hands over the engineering to CSE Engineer, Project on the most complex project cases for execution on the Start-up meeting 

Key tasks in the KONE Delivery process   

  • Accountable for layout creation 

  • Analyses change requirements, and makes proposals for the new solution plan 

  • Provides necessary details to the CSE Specialist for ordering materials and completing the documentation process 

  • Proposes change order (variations and addworks) sales opportunities to the Project Manager 

  • Provides solution-related information to Project Managers, Installation Supervisors and Maintenance Supervisors 

CSE Engineer, Solution role in the KONE SEB process   

  • Shares knowledge with maintenance as needed  

General responsibilities 

  • Participates in product and new services release information-sharing sessions 

  • Provides technical trainings to Sales, Installation and Maintenance as per Front Line needs 

  • Offers input to the product offering management about customisation, standardisation and interface requirements for the portfolio 

  • Contribution to the Customer Solutions Engineering virtual and local network 

  • Contribute to and utilise the Customer Solutions Engineering case library 

  • Handles engineering on Modernisation (MOD) including component upgrades (small VB repairs), full replacement (FBR) or existing building lifts (EBULI) 

  • Is the primary front line technical contact person for the Supply Line Tendering Engineers 

Are you the one?

  • Holistic understanding of different building types and customer segments 

  • Good solution and value-selling skills 

  • Excellent skills in understanding and translating customer needs (requirements) into KONE technical specifications 

  • Understanding of new construction and building modernisation processes in the industry and at KONE 

  • Excellent technical knowledge of KONE current and future solutions (e.g. Advanced People Flow APF solutions) 

  • Good knowledge of KONE solution-related codes and standards 

  • Good knowledge of environmental and sustainability requirements and norms 

  • Good engineering tool skills e.g. CAD and BIM skills 

  • Basic knowledge of competitors’ technical solutions 

  • VB Specific knowledge: Conducting site surveys, existing building modernisation/installation methods 

  • Good understanding of all the required elements for solution total costing 

  • Understanding of KONE quality management procedures 

  • Good virtual collaboration skills 

What’s On Offer

  • Career progression in opportunities within a global organization

  • Total reward elements that engage and motivate our employees and help us make KONE a great place to work

  • Comprehensive learning and development programs covering a wide range of professional skills

  • You are surrounded by fun colleagues and a lively working environment. The best part is all leaders are great and open-minded


To Be Considered

Click the Apply button and complete the online application process. A member of our Talent and Culture team will review your application and will be in contact with additional information accordingly.

In the meantime, feel free to browse our website for additional information on our company, brands and culture – KONE Corporation.

results.title: Package (Project) Engineer (Rotating/Industrial Equipment / ETO Projects) - 1 year contract
results.description:
We are hiring a Package Project Engineer (1-year contract - renewable) to support end-to-end project execution across engineering, procurement, manufacturing, and delivery phases. This role requires strong coordination, technical understanding, and stakeholder management to ensure successful project outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

  • Project Execution & Coordination - Support and drive project execution across engineering, procurement, manufacturing, testing, and delivery phases. Plan, monitor, and track project schedules, deliverables, and milestones to ensure timely completion
  • Customer & Stakeholder Management - Act as a key point of contact for customers, vendors, and internal stakeholders to ensure smooth communication and alignment
  • Technical & Engineering Support - Interpret technical specifications, review engineering documents (e.g., P&ID, process calculations), and ensure compliance with customer requirements
  • Procurement & Vendor Coordination - Coordinate with suppliers on material delivery, monitor vendor performance, and expedite procurement activities
  • Project Control & Risk Management - Monitor project costs, budgets, and resource allocation. Identify risks, issues, and deviations, and propose mitigation plans
  • Quality, Documentation & Compliance - Ensure proper documentation control, submission, and approvals throughout the project lifecycle
  • Contract Administration & Payment Support - Assist in cost monitoring, invoicing, and milestone payments follow-up




Requirements

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Mechanical Engineering or related discipline
  • Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in package engineering/project engineering or project execution (preferably Engineering-To-Order equipment projects)
  • Experience in oil & gas, chemical, marine, or rotating equipment industry is an advantage
  • Strong understanding of project lifecycle (engineering, procurement, manufacturing, delivery)
  • Experience in reviewing and managing engineering documentation (e.g., P&ID, technical specs, vendor drawings)
  • Strong understanding of engineering project execution within manufacturing or industrial equipment environments.

We are looking for someone who is:

  • Engineering-focused rather than purely project-management focused
  • Comfortable owning technical documentation and engineering reviews
  • Able to work independently with minimal supervision
  • Detail-oriented and systematic in managing engineering deliverables
  • Strong in stakeholder communication across customers, suppliers, and internal teams
  • Curious, proactive, and eager to learn new products and technologies
  • Able to balance technical engineering requirements with commercial and project objectives


You are likely a strong fit if you currently work as:

  • Package Engineer
  • Project Engineer (Industrial Equipment)
  • Application Engineer
  • Mechanical Project Engineer
  • Rotating Equipment Engineer
  • Process Equipment Engineer
  • Systems Engineer
  • Engineering Coordinator within an ETO environment


This role is less suited for candidates whose experience is primarily:

  • Construction site supervision
  • Pure maintenance operations
  • Installation-only roles
  • Civil project execution
  • Pure project management without technical engineering ownership

results.title: ATE Test Development Engineer / Product Engineer / Post Silicon Validation Engineer
results.description:
ATE Test Development / Product / Post-Silicon Validation Engineer

Position: ATE Test Development Engineer / Product Engineer / Post-Silicon Validation Engineer
Experience: Minimum 2 years
Qualification: Degree in Electrical / Electronics Engineering or comparable discipline
Industry: Semiconductor / Electronics

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced ATE Test Development / Product / Post-Silicon Validation Engineer with strong technical, analytical and problem-solving capabilities.

The successful candidate should have a good understanding of semiconductor fabrication, testing and manufacturing processes, with hands-on exposure to ATE test platforms, product engineering, yield analysis and engineering debug activities.

The role requires an independent, resourceful engineer who can work effectively with internal Operations teams and external subcontractors to support both NPI and sustaining products.

Key Responsibilities

  • Drive Final Test and Wafer Sort yield improvement, cycle-time reduction and quality improvement initiatives.
  • Support daily engineering debug activities, technical investigations and problem resolution.
  • Perform data collection, analysis and engineering report generation.
  • Generate, organize and maintain documentation relating to product manufacturability.
  • Support lot-on-hold disposition based on appropriate technical analysis and engineering judgement.
  • Generate and analyse yield and Pareto reports.
  • Coordinate with internal Operations teams and external subcontractors to facilitate testing of NPI and sustaining devices.
  • Support ATE test execution, troubleshooting and test-related engineering activities.
  • With Verigy 93K tool experience is an added advantage
  • Analyse test results and identify opportunities for yield, quality and manufacturing improvements.
  • Work independently and collaboratively with cross-functional engineering and manufacturing teams.

Requirements

  • Degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering or a comparable discipline.
  • Minimum 2 years of relevant semiconductor industry experience.
  • Experience in Product Engineering, Test Engineering, Post-Silicon Validation or related semiconductor manufacturing functions.
  • Good understanding of semiconductor fabrication, testing and manufacturing processes.
  • Experience with ATE test patterns, test flows, test execution and debugging.
  • Hands-on experience in ATE testing and data analysis.
  • Experience with Teradyne ETS88, ETS364 and/or UltraFLEX (UFlex) is preferred.
  • Programming or scripting proficiency in C++ and/or Python is advantageous.
  • Strong analytical and technical problem-solving skills.
  • Good written, verbal and presentation skills.
  • Strong interpersonal and organizational skills.
  • Able to work independently and be resourceful when resolving engineering issues.

Preferred Candidate Profile

Candidates with hands-on experience in Wafer Sort, Final Test, Product Engineering, ATE Debug, Yield Improvement, NPI or Post-Silicon Validation are strongly encouraged to apply.

postedCompany.name: GOAL SETTERZ BUSINESS SOLUTIONS PTE. LTD.
postedCompany.description:
Goal Setterz Singapore Recruitment Agency has been established since 2010 and is a reputed recruitment agency in Singapore. Both our company and each of our individual consultants are licensed by the Ministry of Manpower (License no: 10C4764) and we adhere to the highest standards of professional ethics and practices as a Singapore employment agency.


As one of Singapore’s leading recruitment agencies, we provide the staffing link between job seekers and employers. We represent clients from a wide spectrum of industries and from both local small and medium enterprises (SME)s and multi-national corporations (MNC)s
